english.note: Use V + 得 + 平 when an action such as selling is done at a low price.

examples.english: The vegetables at this shop are sold at a low price, so neighbours come to buy them all the time.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖啲菜賣得平，街坊成日嚟買。
